name: Cron Tasks
description: Manage scheduled background cron jobs with simple or advanced time controls, file browser, root toggle, and immediate execution.
author: LinNAS Team

commands.cron_status_cmd: systemctl status cron 2>/dev/null || systemctl status crond 2>/dev/null || service cron status 2>/dev/null || which cron 2>/dev/null || echo 'inactive'
commands.install_cron_sudo: apt-get update && DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get install -y cron && systemctl enable --now cron
commands.start_cron_sudo: systemctl enable --now cron 2>/dev/null || service cron start 2>/dev/null || crond -b 2>/dev/null
